name: Bath'rah the Windwatcher
summary: Near Chillwind Point, Bath'rah the Windwatcher studies the northern winds in the Alterac Mountains. Far from his tropical homeland, the jungle troll shaman seeks champions strong enough to shape the tempest into weapons.

sections.title: Hermit of the Peaks
sections.body: Bath'rah the Windwatcher keeps to the cold ruins of the Alterac Mountains. Jungle trolls usually dwell among warm forests and coasts, far from these peaks. A seasoned shaman and craftsman, he listens to the wind and communes with nature spirits. He means to bind violent storms into weapons for those strong enough to wield them.

sections.title: Master of Cyclonian
sections.body: Cyclonian is a monstrous wind elemental in the peaks around Bath'rah. He cannot defeat it alone, so he calls on seasoned warriors and shamans to gather exotic elemental essences and summon the creature. When Cyclonian is slain, Bath'rah claims its elemental heart. He uses it to make legendary weapons of raw tempest, renowned across Azeroth.

faq.answer: Bath'rah is a jungle troll shaman and weaponcrafter living in seclusion among ruins near Chillwind Point in the Alterac Mountains. He helps seasoned adventurers harness elemental power in weapons.

faq.q: Why is a jungle troll living in Alterac?
faq.answer: Bath'rah lives as a hermit near Chillwind Point, studying elemental power and helping capable adventurers forge weapons. The reason he left his homeland is not established.
Cyclonian is a massive, violent wind elemental haunting the ruins around Bath'rah's sanctuary. Bath'rah needs its core to forge weapons infused with elemental wind.

faq.q: Why do warriors seek him out?
faq.answer: Warriors travel from across the world to Bath'rah because he knows how to forge the Whirlwind weapons. Under his guidance, defeating Cyclonian yields arms infused with howling gales.

faq.q: Does Bath'rah only help members of the Horde?
faq.answer: Bath'rah lives apart from major faction politics as a solitary hermit. He focuses on elemental craft and helps capable warriors and shamans who respect the spirits and aid his elemental work.

angles.text: Veteran fighters know Bath'rah for guiding them through the trials to forge Whirlwind weapons with the essence of Cyclonian, the wind elemental.
As a fellow master of the elements, Bath'rah shares a deep spiritual connection with shamans seeking closer communion with the spirits of earth, water, and air.
